maximum_permitted_stay: Up to 90 days; duration and validity are as granted on the territorial visa sticker.
passport_validity_rule: Passport issued within 10 years, at least 2 blank pages, and valid 3 months beyond intended stay. Dhaka checklist says 3 months after leaving Schengen; territory-only calculation is not separately stated.
blank_passport_pages_rule: At least two blank pages per the Bangladesh mission checklist.
return_ticket_rule: Round-trip or onward transport booking and itinerary for the entire planned stay.
proof_of_funds_rule: Six-month personal bank statements; company statements if self-employed; no fixed minimum stated.
accommodation_rule: Hotel reservation for the full stay or host invitation and accommodation evidence.
travel_insurance_rule: A visa valid only for Faroe Islands/Greenland does not require travel medical insurance. If a separate Schengen visa is also required for transit, insurance must cover at least EUR 30,000 and include the relevant territory as well as Schengen.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: No destination-specific health rule in cited visa guidance; check current health notices.
transit_rule: A Schengen visa alone does not admit to Faroe Islands/Greenland. Most routes transit through Schengen, so a separate Schengen visa is usually needed. A C visa or another Schengen D visa without territorial validity does not grant entry; an entry permit may be required if already in Denmark. Qualifying Danish/Schengen residence permits or EU family-member residence cards can exempt the holder from the territorial visa.
application_channel: Apply via ApplyVisa; submit in person at Denmark's Dhaka VAC; Embassy decides.
application_fee: EUR 90 adult; EUR 45 ages 6–11; under 6 no visa fee. VFS service fee EUR 19 (BDT 2,735); subject to change.
processing_time: 15 days from Embassy receipt; may extend to 45. VFS also lists an exceptional 60-day case; confirm. Handling time excluded.

notes: Bangladesh ordinary passport holders need a pre-arranged territorial visa for tourism unless they qualify for the Danish Immigration Service's 2026 residence-permit or EU family-card exemption. review_notes: France-Visas' Monaco FAQ states that a valid Schengen visa permits entry to Monaco and that Schengen residence-permit holders may enter without a short-stay visa. Where a short-stay visa is required and Monaco is the main destination, the French consulate issues a Schengen visa valid for Monaco and the Schengen area. EU Regulation 2018/1806 Annex I lists Bangladesh as visa-required for Schengen short stays. France-Visas Bangladesh directs applicants to apply online and submit in person through VFS Dhaka; the French Embassy in Dhaka decides. Long-stay cases are separate and referred to the Monegasque authorities.
notes: A Bangladesh ordinary passport holder needs a short-stay Schengen visa when no qualifying exemption applies. A valid Schengen visa permits entry to Monaco; a residence permit issued by a Schengen State also permits visa-free entry. If Monaco is the main destination, the French consulate issues a Schengen visa valid for Monaco and the Schengen area. Long-stay applications follow a separate procedure involving the Monegasque authorities.

maximum_permitted_stay: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period; the visa sticker may grant fewer days.
passport_validity_rule: Issued within 10 years; valid at least 3 months after Schengen departure; at least 2 blank pages.
blank_passport_pages_rule: At least two blank pages per the Bangladesh tourist checklist.
return_ticket_rule: Round-trip airline reservation with PNR and itinerary; onward permit if applicable.
proof_of_funds_rule: Finland requires EUR 50/day; Dhaka checklist asks for six-month bank statements and solvency evidence.
accommodation_rule: Hotel confirmation for the whole stay or other proof of accommodation.
travel_insurance_rule: Required for the full Schengen stay; minimum EUR 30,000, valid across all Schengen states.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: No destination-specific health rule in cited visa guidance; check current health notices.
transit_rule: The Finnish Schengen visa covers Åland; a single-entry visa cannot be used to re-enter Schengen after leaving.
application_channel: Sweden Embassy Dhaka represents Finland; apply in person through VFS Global Dhaka.
application_fee: EUR 90 (BDT 12,870 adult); VFS BDT 1,573 plus BDT 230 payment fee; subject to change.
processing_time: Normally 15 calendar days; may extend to 45; allow extra time for appointment and submission.
required_documents: Completed and signed Schengen short-stay visa application form|Original passport issued within 10 years with at least two blank pages and required validity|One recent colour photograph, 35 x 45 mm|Previous passports and relevant Schengen visas, where available|Cover letter explaining the tourism itinerary|Round-trip flight reservation with PNR and itinerary|Hotel confirmation or accommodation voucher for the full stay|Six-month bank statements and proof of financial solvency|Travel medical insurance with minimum EUR 30,000 coverage|Employment, business, student or retirement evidence appropriate to the applicant|Civil-status documents where relevant and parental consent for minors where required|Additional documents requested by the Swedish Embassy or VFS

cross_check_source_name: Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Finland — Visa to visit Finland
review_notes: Finland Abroad's Bangladesh-specific page confirms that an ordinary Bangladesh passport requires a Schengen visa. Åland is covered by Finland's Schengen arrangements, subject to its special Åland provisions. The Embassy of Sweden in Dhaka represents Finland for visa matters; VFS Bangladesh provides the local tourist checklist, 35 x 45 mm photo specification, 15–45 day processing estimate and service charges. The VFS sources are classified as authorized-provider sources, not government sources. The Finnish MFA's funds guidance gives EUR 50 per day. The record is for tourism to Åland, not a separate visa class.
notes: Åland is an autonomous region of Finland and follows Finland/Schengen short-stay entry rules; no separate Åland visa is issued. Finland is represented by Sweden in Bangladesh. The Finnish MFA states a minimum of EUR 50 per day. VFS charges are separate from the government fee and are subject to change.
